notes.title: Back on the Slopes: The New WRS2 Update Is Here!
notes.content:
Things have been rather quiet around Winter Resort Simulator 2 over the past few months – maybe even a bit too quiet. Many of you have been wondering whether anything was still happening with the game. That’s exactly why we’re here now – to give you an update!

The main reason for the recent silence was the release of SubwaySim 2. Finishing such a large project took a lot out of our team. So we’re even more excited to now return to Winter Resort Simulator 2 with full energy after this intense period.

While we can’t reveal too much about the future of the game just yet, we’re here to deliver something that’s been a long time coming: the official release of Update 16!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39027791/b5ff4da8b3988abe1f076eeb9ef44d1f19dcce0e.jpg[/img]

At last, the time has come: Update 16 is leaving beta and is now available for all players. Alongside various bug fixes, the update also includes several handy quality-of-life improvements – especially for our modding community.

➡️  Highlights
[list]
[*] Riedkopfbahn now automatically couples/garages when both sections are open and the same spacing is set.
[*] Riedkopfbahn now starts correctly when both sections are coupled.
[*] Ski huts operate independently of the time of day.
[*] Skiers now only despawn shortly before the area closes – meaning evening skiing is finally possible.
[*] MP Join Screen: Clicking on missing mods now leads to the Steam Workshop.
[*] A button to prepare all pistes at once.
[*] Simuverse rebranding.
[/list]

➡️  Bugfixes & Improvements
[list]
[*] Minimap fix for 1440p resolution,
[*] Missing switch added to Hexenkessel Berg,
[*] Direct button to open log.txt in case of loading errors,
[*] AutoStop gameplay setting now only affects the player’s own vehicle,
[*] Winch should now tension correctly when joining in MP,
[*] Fuel price reduced to €1.50,
[*] Bug fix related to upcoming weather situations,
[*] Bug fix for SnowGroomer MP synchronisation.
[/list]

➡️  Modding
[list]
[*] New API function: EntryLaneWaypoint.isNPCApproaching(),
[*] New API function: ModListener.onObjectDeselected,
[*] New map option: skiResort.skierUseTerrainOnly for DonChris Ski Hall,
[*] RWDefaultConstructor now supports carrierWeight for more realistic sag,
[*] Event RWControl:onSoundTriggered() now also includes the CarrierId.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the update! And if you thought things might quiet down now... you might be in for a surprise. ;)

notes.title: A new BRAND!
notes.content:
After a long time, we have news for you today, and it's for a very special reason: For almost 7 years now, we have been dedicated to developing exciting and technically accurate simulation games. During this time, we have achieved incredible things and have grown in many ways. One particular highlight was the release of WRS in the winter of 2019.

We are even more pleased to announce that we are now incorporating our passion for excellent simulators into our name. From now on, HR Innoways will be known as Simuverse Interactive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39027791/ae7f848e769209154f79a5c6148875d158da1578.jpg[/img]

Starting today, we will release all our games under this new name, and Winter Resort Simulator 2 will also undergo a small rebranding.

What is particularly important to us is that despite this change, the same team remains behind the company, and our mission to create top-notch simulation games remains unchanged.

This brings us to the question many of you are probably asking right now:

[b]What's next for WRS?[/b]

In the coming weeks, we plan to release a smaller update. We want to fulfill some long-held wishes of the modding community and support some modders with small "quality of life" features. Additionally, there will be some minor bug fixes.

As for the future of WRS, we have many plans - and we can hardly wait until the time comes when we can share more with you. Until then, we ask for a bit more patience. But the good news is: we have not forgotten the game.

Cheers to a promising future!

notes.title: Winter Resort Simulator 2 | Update 14
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that we have just released Update 14 to all players. It includes a few important bugfixes and many improvements, in particular for modders!

Feel free to scroll through the comprehensive changelog:

▶️  GENERAL
[b]- Added auto-backups for lua savegames every time when loading (requested by some players)
- Fixed wrong texture on slot #2 for non-Riedstein terrains
- Added /fixAccountingAssets command. This will remove unwanted depreciation costs
- Fixed a bug that could break savegames together with ABM's custom signs mod[/b]
- Some multiplayer fixes and better logging
- Added help labels for the in-game object editor
- Removed maintenance cost for winch anchors
- Riedstein default savegame now does not have any unwanted costs, thus much better balanced
- Riedkopfbahn is now less expensive
- Fixed issues with DLCs not being active on savegames by default
- Added Disclaimer line to log.txt so that players are aware that logfiles may include personal data
- Added new loading screen images
- Diesel price adjusted to current market situation (1.80 € per liter)
- Fixed display errors in helpline description texts (all languages affected except for German)

▶️  ROPEWAYS
[b]- Fixed bug with wrong capacity on Riedkopfbahn section 2
- Omega IV-10 D and Omega V now have recolorable grips![/b]
- Riedkopfbahn carrier count now limited to 85 for both sections
- Riedkopfbahn AI now shows status "initializing" directly after building.
- Slow speed button in Riedkopfbahn parking now only affects the currently active section
- Fixed windows on Omega IV-8 LWI
- Fixed issues with Riedkopfbahn AI initialization process.
- Fixed issues with Riedkopfbahn AI on ropeways with extremely short section 1
- Fixed issues with Riedkopfbahn connection track on almost straight ropeways
- Carrier spacings on multiple sections fixed (e.g. for the Sennigratbahn mod)
- Limited carrier count on multiple sections fixed (e.g. for Riedkopfbahn)

▶️  MODDING
- New Lua API functions as per request of a modder: GameControl.setCameraAllowRotZ() and GameControl.getCameraAllowRotZ()
- New Lua API classes as per request of a modder: EntryLaneEnter and EntryLaneLeave
- Renamed data tables of DLC ropeways as preparation for a public version of Lua data tables
- Riedkopfbahn1AI renamed to RiedkopfbahnAI for better clarity.

Enjoy the update!

notes.title: Update 6 released!
notes.content:
We have just released Update 6!

These are the highlights:
- Multiplayer Management Screen for game hosts in the ESC menu
- Salisjochbahn now has a B spacing!
- Added a progress bar for MP game uploads!
- Fixed issues with MP map upload for players with slow internet connection!
- Bugfixes regarding snow melting on used slopes
- Added configurable deadzone for Joysticks
- MP game list now shows the map name of every game
- Fixed rare crash when selling vehicles
- several bugfixes, and even some more new features!

Enjoy the update! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39027791/01369ab650cd0913156f87c09a9c245cff789710.png[/img]

Here's the detailled changelog:

General:
- Gameplay Settings now splitted into categories for better overview
- Added configurable deadzone for joysticks
- Fixed missing traffic vehicles after going back to main menu
- Fixed localisation of error message when no connection to a MP game could be established
- Fixed lost guests when reloading savegames
- Fixed issues with molten snow on used slopes
- Fixed crash after remapping a controls key, then leaving the menu, then opening and leaving again without setting the key another time
- Added map upload progress bar

Ropeways:
- Salisjochbahn now has a B spacing (without the middle track)! Spacing switches are located in both stations
- All spacing switches of ropeways are automatically adjusted whenever spacing is adjusted, and ambiguous switch positions are now fixed
- Fixed sound of ropeway control fan when turning ropeway control off (was not disabled correctly before)

Multiplayer:
- Added Multiplayer Management Screen (available for the host in the ESC menu)
--> features include kicking, allowing (auto-accept) and banning of players
--> You can also change the game name and player limit of an open game now!
- The MP game list screen now also shows the name of the map which you'll be joining
- Improved ban system

Vehicles:
- Fixed missing motor sound when engine is running while joining a MP game
- Pistenbully / Prinoth rope winch will no longer detach when loading a savegame
- Fixed rare crash when selling vehicles with delivery packages in them
- Vattenmask can now be sold by clicking the back part as well

Modding:
- Fixed onGUI of entities being called twice per frame in SP
- Minor refinements in ropeway-related backend code
- Minor refinements in vehicle-related code
- Improved error message when streamReadBit() runs against buffer limit
- Changed arguments of RWControl:setNetworkSwitchCallback(switchId, buttonName, callback) - buttonName has now been added
- Added some events for ropeway control extension scripts (Added onReset, readResync, writeResync, readUpdate, writeUpdate, writeUpdateStation, readUpdateStation and onStartMoving)

notes.content:
From today on, there will be a publicbeta with cutting-edge (but untested) patch versions available for Season 2!
At the same time, we are publishing Patch 2 for the public beta branch.
Many important bugs have been fixed, including a total rework of the snow system.

Please keep in mind that all patches on publicbeta are test versions. There may be errors, e.g. when converting savegames to the new versions, and you might have problems when loading publicbeta savegames back in the default game version.
Therefore: Please make a backup of savegames in case they are valuable to you before loading them in the publicbeta.

These are the highlights of patch 2:
- Snow height before grooming will be stored internally as "compressedSnow" => Problems with snow melting too fast fixed
- Restaurants can generate profit again
- Fixed a lot of bugs in snow system
- The artefacts on slopes after grooming at low FPS are fixed
- Vehicle motor sound is not flipped anymore
- Severe ropeway carrier jam situations should be fixed now
- and many more!

You'll find the detailled changelog on Discord >> https://discordapp.com/invite/Z4qJV6K

Enjoy the new version!

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
The first patch (1.0.1) for Winter Resort Simulator Season 2 is here, including a lot of bugfixes and changes!

The [b]highlights[/b]: 
- Fixed fullscreen mode and changing resolutions
- Fixed MP join issues for many players (however this does not yet fix all multiplayer issues)
- Improved matchmaking server stability and clearer error messages
- MP join requests will automatically be rejected after some time
- Added automatic launching switch for Doppelmayr Connect
- Added multiplayer synchronization for lift and slope states (visible on client infoboards as well)
- Fixed several issues in Hallstein Season 2 eco system. Please start a new savegame to profit from the fixes
- Fixed Leitwolf grooming issues
- and many more...

Feel free to test it out right now! 


Here's the [b]complete changelog[/b]:

Major changes
- Fullscreen mode is working correctly now!
- Bloom is back in the game!
- Lift and slope states on the infoboard are MP-synchronized now!
- SDK mod lift added for savegame compatibility (but not yet with all features).
- Fixed terrain rendering issues when snow is disabled in editor.

Multiplayer
- Improved overall matchmaking server stability!
- Improved network stability in general!
- Fixed frequent issues with UDP timeouts after joining!
- Two subsequent WAN join requests can now be correctly accepted.
- Fixed issues when staying in the game list screen for too long.
- Join requests are automatically rejected after 24s if the host does not respond.
- Fixed issues on leaving multiplayer and going back to main menu (added a new UI screen).
- Added messages when connection to matchmaking server was lost.
- Timeout messages are now more precise (UDP/TCP separated).

Ropeways
- Automatic Launching switch added also for all Doppelmayr Connect ropeways!
- Better guest distribution in Dorfbahn valley station.
- Fixed issues with switch states when loading savegames (e.g. resulting in incorrect speeds).
- Fixed some belts in both Salisjoch stations (incoming side).
- Fixed misplaced ring button in Höllwiesenlift valley station.
- Fixes in Omega IV LOD.
- Sound positions in Hexenkessel valley station fixed.
- Salisjoch carrier LOD fixed (missing suspension).
- Minor fix with ready signal in the Hexenkessel/Salisjoch/Höllwiesen control.

UI/HUD
- Nickname rendering improved (orange as new default color + visible from farther away)!
- Cruise control gameplay setting removed. Please use the O key instead!
- Improvements to French localisation. Thanks to The snowman73!
- Fixed issues with the main menu leave popup.
- Escape Menu can no longer be called during loading.
- Minor loca fixes.
- Fixed Höllwiesenlift preview image.

Vehicles
- Fixed several issues with the Pistenbully 600's and Leitwolf's rope winch in Multiplayer!
- Snow Blade range increased!
- Cruise Control disabled in reverse!
- Fixed Leitwolf grooming issue!
- No more groomer particles when in buildings!
- Performance optimization for groomer particles!
- Improved Leitwolf winch hook collision.
- Leitwolf door cylinder fixed.
- Leitwolf speed adjusted towards Pistenbully 600 speed.
- Fixed missing snow impact on Pistenbully 600W (left side).
- Fixed a groomer bug when lowering over the mechanics pit in the garage.
- Snow impact/displacement now works on maps with offset != 0.

Map
- Höllwiesenlift downhill rides disabled!
- Fixed issues with slope points (resulting in distorted guest distribution)!
- Fixed slope markers on slope 3.
- Fixed Stubhornbahn riders count.

Modding
- C# Logging in log.txt is now more verbose!
- Fixed ambiguities with vehicle "winch wheels" (axis 1 = Rotation on X and no longer axis 0)!

Missions/Gameplay/EcoSystem
- Added Console command /setReputation!
- Fixed a severe bug with missions that freezes the game!
- Grooming slopes is now cheaper!
- Delivery objects are now correctly destroyed when going back to main menu!
- Deliveries are back on Hallstein V1!
- Better guest distribution for bidirectional ropeways (guests can now ride a lift up or down to arrive at a restaurant or slope that they like).
- Delivery trigger is hidden in Multiplayer.
- Minor Console command improvements.

notes.title: The release is coming closer!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39027791/4f76c6100781351046146f7a70b19a4083efc4c5.png[/img]
With big steps the release of Season 2 is coming closer. Therefore we would like to explain to you which editions of Season 2 are available and which of them is the right one for you.

All those who already own the first part will get the new main game Winter Resort Simulator Season 2 with the multiplayer and the new snow system for free! Optionally you can buy the additional vehicles and cable cars as well as the new game world for €19.95 in the Season 2 - Content Pack (DLC).

If you do not yet own the Winter Resort Simulator, you can buy everything together in the Season 2 - Complete Edition for €29.95. The Complete Edition has the same content as the main game together with the Content Pack.

For illustration please have a look at the graphic above!

notes.title: The Marmotta Venture
notes.content:
There is even a new car in the Winter Resort Simulator Season 2 - Complete Edition: the Marmotta Venture! You can design this nice SUV yourself and then bring up to 5 people to their destination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39027791/0d554bfa8266c43b4fd3f8aadc81dd13856f5375.png[/img]

notes.title: The Marmotta Tiger X860R
notes.content:
No matter how difficult and slippery the ground might be – you will be able to overcome any obstacle in Winter Resort Simulator Season 2 - Complete Edition with the agile Marmotta Tiger X860R! 

There is a version with tyres and one with crawlers, so that no off-road area will cause you any problems. On top of that, you can also dye the vehicle a different color. 

Great, isn’t it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39027791/7c1b5e7d27ea6ca71272981381166af88631ca29.png[/img]
